name: stats
useFor: Use for two to four figures that matter (orders a day, stores reached). Pass stats with value, label and an optional window name.
constraints: More than four in a row
documentation: `Stats` props: `title`, `description`, `stats` (`{ value, label, name? }[]`), plus div props.
source: Extension in the opencommerce site's voice (the live numbers in monitoring.tsx and features.tsx, globals.css .win)
title: Stats
description: Figures in windows: the number in the display face, its label under it, in a row that wraps, under an optional heading.
